title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G.L. c 164, § 94G 1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 528 for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the biling months of July, August and Septment 1988. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the respetive costs of burning coal and oil.
